name: Critical Anomaly

  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

Balanced barrel.

Ultra-light barrel.

perks.name: Full Bore

Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.desc: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 111 from 30 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4KO3Yr8AkPRBgKlNmacrGS?si=6dfa9e466dde41a0) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE / PvE-Utility / PvE-Champion / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for anti-Champion use. Shapeable. Base stats are excellent by comparison to its peers, and equate to 0.45s ADS speed, 0.44s ready and 0.39s stow speed, and 3.30s reload speed. Handling is always useful on aggressive snipers - stability is less of a concern if you pace your shots - so Fluted Barrel is the barrel perk to choose. Even though it tanks your reload to 3.72s, Extended Mag plus a Backup Mag mod takes you to 5 shots (so maybe a reload mod on your boots will help?). That's important for Chill Clip in the first trait slot, as it means you'll have three Chill Clip shots. For anti-Champion use, one shot will slow and disrupt an Overload champion and two will freeze and stun an Unstoppable (with a third shot ready, just in case). You can also pierce barriers by simply becoming radiant, and all at a nice, safe range. The second column trait is less important as this is more of a utility roll, but you'll likely have built up two stacks of Chaos Reshaped in your back pocket for a chunky +35% damage boost. The Collective Purpose origin trait only works in a fireteam, but offers small boosts to range and handling, which is always useful. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Critical Anomaly has one of the most interesting perks we have seen on a sniper rifle. Chill Clip allows you to stun 2/3 champions with one weapon and this season’s Radiant Orbs brings in the third allowing you to take care of all three champions with one weapon. Outside of the champion situation you have Rewind Rounds and Reconstruction for ammo and Bait and Switch or Firing Line for damage. Another interesting combination is either Rewind Rounds or Reconstruction with Triple Tap for a harder hitting Supremacy with less shots." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I’m not gonna lie, the combination of Quickdraw and Snapshot Sights on an aggressive frame sniper gets me interested in this raid, I just don’t want to have to raid multiple weeks in a row to get all the red borders to craft this stinking weapon. For most players the combination of Snapshot Sights and Opening Shot will give you a similar feel to Mechabre or the old Bite of the Fox. Different scopes so do try it out if you like sniping." Recommended MW: Handling.
